task.description: Verify ISS-0416's own suspected mechanism (cross-process DB contention) by reproducing it in a genuinely clean environment, per the issue's own explicit ask.

result.summary: Confirmed no other mix test process was running (ps aux check) before re-running test/letflow/service_catalog_test.exs alone 8 consecutive times with different seeds (1-8): 33/33 passed every single run, zero intermittent AC7 failures. This confirms the original occurrence was purely cross-process DB contention from a second concurrently-running agent's own full-suite mix test, not a genuine per-test isolation bug. Closed as no_defect, no code change needed.
